newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: POLYGRAM TAKES 25 PCT STAKE IN TURKISH FIRM.
newsitem.headline: POLYGRAM TAKES 25 PCT STAKE IN TURKISH FIRM.

text.p: Music and entertainment group PolyGram said on Tuesday it had acquired a 25 percent stake in the four main music labels of Raks Muzik which it described as Turkey's leading record company.
Philips Electronics NV has a 75 percent stake in PolyGram.
PolyGram said Raks Muzik had a 36 percent share of the Turkish recorded music market. The Turkish market as a whole was estimated to be worth $90 million in 1995.
Media and entertainment group Raks Holding is the parent company of Raks Muzik whose four main music labels are Plaza Muzik, Nese Muzik, S Muzik and Mars Muzik.
Raks distributes records throughout Turkey and other Turkish speaking areas such as Azerbaijan and Turkmenistan. It has been PolyGram's Turkish licencee since January 1995.

PolyGram quoted Rick Dobbis, president of PolyGram Continental Europe, as saying: "Turkey represents a unique opportunity for us. It is a well developed and and yet still rapidly growing music market."
